title: Act: Add Tailwind, PostCSS configs, directives and design tokens
summary: Create Tailwind and PostCSS configs and update styles.css
description: Add devDependencies, create the two config files and prepend directives plus token variables to src/styles.css, keeping all existing rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frontend, when vite loads, then postcss.config.js registers tailwindcss and autoprefixer
Given styles.css, when read, then directives and tokens precede the existing rules
definition_of_done: Config files created; npm install succeeds

steps.action: Add tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer and tailwindcss-animate to devDependencies, then run npm install in game/frontend
steps.expected: npm install exits 0 and node_modules/tailwindcss exists

steps.action: Create ESM PostCSS config registering tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins
steps.expected: Vite picks up the config automatically

steps.action: Create Tailwind config with darkMode 'class', content globs, theme.extend.colors background/foreground/primary/muted/border using hsl(var(--name)), borderRadius lg using var(--radius), and plugin tailwindcss-animate
steps.expected: tsc accepts the file and the config exports content containing ./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}

steps.action: Insert @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; and a :root block defining --background, --foreground, --primary, --primary-foreground, --muted, --border and --radius with warm dark pixel-RPG HSL values; do not remove any existing rule
steps.expected: styles.css begins with the three directives and still contains .game-layout
